parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom structural part of the storage cabinet, made of plywood for stability and support.
parts.Functional_description: It provides foundational support for the entire cabinet, ensuring balance and weight distribution.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is the front panel that allows access to the interior of the cabinet, made of MDF with a smooth finish.
parts.Functional_description: It opens and closes to provide access to the storage space inside the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges attached to the cabinet frame.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structure of the cabinet, made of plywood for rigidity and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the door, shelves, and base, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed structural component and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Top)
parts.Basic_description: The top shelf is a horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing or organizing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: The middle shelf is a central horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the cabinet space and supports stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: The bottom shelf is the lowest horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports heavier items and contributes to the cabinet’s internal structure.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.
